concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-verification-overview]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace capability-verification overview for creation, data changes, tier moves and data reviews, with v3/v4 adjustable deadlines and asynchronous webhooks.
warnings: Higher-tier payout capabilities are disallowed; the accepting-payment deadline is described as a possible future addition (raw lines 56–60, 198–212), despite general 30/60-day deadline tables.
Legal-entity data changes alone do not trigger balancePlatform.accountHolder.updated; it is sent for capability-related account-holder changes (raw line 52).
